title: stevia veronicae var. tenuis
intro: Stevia veronicae var. tenuis, commonly known as Brazilian stevia, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving blood sugar control, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Stevia veronicae var. tenuis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as steviol glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Stevia veronicae var. tenuis for therapeutic use.
